hero.eyebrow: Built by two people · Porto Alegre, BR
hero.title: We build software the way a mosaic is built — small precise units, placed on purpose.
hero.lead: Tessarion Labs is not a company. It is the name we put on the software we build together — Roger and Alice, one apartment in Porto Alegre, one shared backlog.

about.title: What this is
paragraphs: A name, not a company. Tessarion Labs is what two people call their own work: the software we build for ourselves first, and the standard we hold it to.
There is no office and no payroll. There are two people, a shared backlog, and the hours left over after the day job.
The brand, the written specs and the design system exist because we would rather build one product properly than five in a hurry. That is the whole plan.
about.callout: Two people and the hours left over is the entire capacity. One product moves at a time and the other waits. That is the trade, and it is why Taimu and Mascada are both still in development.

people.title: Who builds it

members.name: Roger Oliveira
members.bio: Eleven years in production, four of them at ADP, where he led the HR module modernization that grew adoption 634% in a product that went on to rank #1 of 125,912 in the 2025 G2 Best Software Awards. Now an AI engineer contracting from Brazil for a US company: LLM extraction pipelines, agentic workflows and MCP tooling, all in production. Writes TypeScript, Rust, Python and C#. Everything here started as something he wanted to exist.

photos.alt: Roger Oliveira in a blue suit and red tie, outdoors in a garden.
Roger Oliveira at the beach in a cap and sunglasses, under palm trees.
Roger Oliveira in a black band t-shirt, tattooed arms, in a lift.

members.name: Alice Ribeiro
members.bio: Came to engineering from management, design and social media, and kept all three. Studying Systems Analysis and Development, and working across the web stack — JavaScript, Node.js, React, PHP and Go. On Taimu she takes the interface and the state behind it. She is the reason a pile of ideas turns into a scope, an order and a date.

photos.alt: Alice Ribeiro, dark hair and a tattooed neck, looking at the camera.
Alice Ribeiro in a close portrait, dark hair falling past her shoulders.

people.lead: Roger has more ideas than a week holds. Alice decides which one ships, and in what order. That is the whole division of labour.

items.name: Taimu
paragraphs: A macOS menu-bar app. Start the day, pause, resume, end the day — from the menu bar. A monthly calendar shows each day's intervals, a weekly balance per row, and a monthly total against your goal.
No server and no third-party account. Everything is written as JSON on your own disk.

items.name: Mascada
paragraphs: Accounts, cards and statements, transactions, installment plans, subscriptions, fixed expenses and debts, in one ledger that shows what happened to the money.
A Rust API, a TypeScript web client, and a skill that lets an agent read and write the same ledger you do.

crew.title: The crew
crew.lead: Three assistants. All three are cats.

members.name: Char
members.role: Engineering manager. Runs the standup. Has an opinion on every ticket.
members.bio: Decided he was in charge and nobody filed an objection. Greets every visitor at the door, supervises from the desk, and narrates the whole working day out loud.
members.alt: Char, a black and white cat, lying on a grey couch and looking at the camera.

members.name: Joey
members.role: Security engineer. Trusts one origin. Blocks every request from an unknown host.
members.bio: The largest of the three and the first one under the bed. Allowlists exactly one person, follows him room to room, and treats the doorbell as an incident.
members.alt: Joey, a large black and white cat, sitting upright in a kitchen doorway.

members.name: Reginaldo
members.role: Principal engineer. Longest tenure, owns the legacy system, does not pair.
members.bio: Was here first and has not been impressed since. Declines every toy, keeps his own hours, and reviews the other two from a distance without leaving a comment.
members.alt: Reginaldo, a long-haired black and white cat, settled into a blue blanket.

contact.title: Say hello
contact.lead: If you are building something and want to talk about it, write. We read everything and answer when the day job lets us.
